name: clintware-control
description: Operate Clintware and paired Quillgeist Lite devices through the authenticated MCP control plane, with local-first execution, governed web automation, and CWInteract™ desktop control.

interface.shortDescription: Direct authenticated control of Clintware and paired qq devices.
interface.longDescription: Clintware Control connects ChatGPT and Codex to mcp.clintware.com. It provides live qq status and watchdog check-ins, allowlisted local jobs, durable logs and verification evidence, local-first model routing, governed browser automation, and CWInteract™ for bounded interaction with signed-in Windows apps and browser windows without exposing raw machine or provider credentials.
defaultPrompt: Check MEMORIA live status and continue the current Clintware work without asking me to paste PowerShell output.
Run this eligible task through qq, monitor the durable job, and verify completion.
Use Clintware local-first routing and recover a stuck qq runner only when the evidence shows it is stalled.
Search or operate the live web through my governed qq browser.
